abilities.name: swarm
abilities.effect: Strengthens bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

abilities.name: technician
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: steadfast
abilities.effect: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

kanto.flavorText: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.

original-johto.flavorText: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.

hoenn.flavorText: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

updated-johto.flavorText: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective coloration makes it invisible.

original-unova.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

updated-unova.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

kalos.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Scyther is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

original-alola.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

updated-alola.flavorText: Some call it a ninja. Its movements— imperceptibly quick—are sufficient to cleave the air in two. It’s very popular in Alola.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.

swsh.flavorText: If you come across an area in a forest where a lot of the trees have been cut down, what you’ve found is a Scyther’s territory.

pla.flavorText: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
